command:
set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name apksigner | sort | tail -1)"; APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=link.localclimate.app; EXPECTED_SIGNER=2909c5fe69d075bde3f18d1f50608880b1c6b8041e08b11d37e9eb4942350b76; test -x "$APKSIGNER"; test -f "$APK"; DUMP="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=|targetSdk=' | head -10; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionName=2.0.10'; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionCode=20010'; APK_SIGNER="$("$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" | sed -n 's/^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; test "$APK_SIGNER" = "$EXPECTED_SIGNER"; printf 'verified_build_apk_signer_sha256=%s
' "$APK_SIGNER"; INSTALLED_PATH="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -1)"; test -n "$INSTALLED_PATH"; printf 'installed_apk_path=%s
' "$INSTALLED_PATH"; rm -f /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk; if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" pull "$INSTALLED_PATH" /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk >/tmp/lcl-adb-pull.log 2>&1 && [ -f /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk ]; then INSTALLED_SIGNER="$("$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk | sed -n 's/^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; test "$INSTALLED_SIGNER" = "$EXPECTED_SIGNER"; printf 'verified_installed_apk_signer_sha256=%s
' "$INSTALLED_SIGNER"; else echo 'installed_apk_pull=unavailable; source APK signer verified before clean install'; fi; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; test -n "$PID"; printf 'verified_pid=%s
' "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' | grep "$PACKAGE"
